observation: P0v4 was source-verified but its notebook installed into the mutable base environment, emitted no durable whole-run manifest, and admitted campaign cost from one timing observation. Browser file upload remained blocked before the v0.1.1 candidate reached Kaggle. No market archive or outcome was accessed.
hypothesized_cause: Mutable installation, incomplete run-level binding and single-sample timing could make a heavy 264-cell campaign ambiguous or admit it on an unusually favorable scheduler interval.
change: Freeze P0v5 as a delivery-only amendment: install the exact v0.1.2 wheel offline into a fresh isolated target; reject input symlinks; hash the canonical input inventory; fix numerical thread counts to one; preserve installation verification; require a fresh output root; emit a no-overwrite hash-and-size run manifest; and qualify with three identical measurements using the slowest timing and stable artifact byte counts.
predicted_effect: Kaggle runs become source-isolated and independently auditable, stale outputs cannot be mixed into a new run, and quota admission becomes conservative against timing noise without changing the scientific model or decision rule.
discriminating_experiment: Require 48 warning-strict local tests, Ruff, strict mypy, offline lock validation, notebook compilation, two byte-identical fixed-epoch wheel builds, clean-wheel execution under both admitted runtime pairs, identical generated evidence hashes, and finally a passing Kaggle P0v5 qualification receipt.
